thread:
lina: FYI — ZetaCorp reporting 502/504s from the hosted inference API starting ~09:12 UTC. They see gateway errors and an auth/session timeout in responses. Ticket SUP-9823. Can SRE triage?

oncall-bot: alert: 09:12 UTC — 5xx spike observed for org=zeta-corp region=us-west-2 metric=api.responses.affected_routes=all

lina: Minimal repro from the customer:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
{
  "error": "gateway_error",
  "message": "upstream error from routing-policy service",
  "debug": "routing-policy-timeout"
}
```
They say it affects all models and multiple customers in the same org.

raj: I'm on it. Any pattern on headers/route? Is this only hosted (api.redwood.ai) or dedicated too?

lina: Only hosted so far (us-west-2). Happening across generation and chat endpoints.

mike: Looking at control-plane logs now. Routing-policy svc is returning 504s to the gateway with config-db timeouts. Also seeing intermittent redis (session-store) ETIMEDOUTs around the same window.

raj: Pasting the relevant log snippet from routing-policy: 
```
ERROR getPolicy failed org=zeta-corp err="configdb query timed out after 1500ms" request_id=abc-123
WARN cache miss for org=zeta-corp, fallback=false
```

mike: Config DB (postgres) read latency spiked — p95 reads jumped to ~2s and some queries timed out at 1500ms which is our routing-policy threshold. Looking at pooled connections; exhausted briefly.

lina: Customer stack traces include this header from our gateway: `x-rw-error: routing-policy-timeout` and `x-rw-session: auth-timeout`.

raj: Quick repro we ran against prod gateway shows identical behavior:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health/check-routing
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
< x-rw-error: routing-policy-timeout
```

mike: Mitigation options: 1) enable cached routing fallback in the gateway for affected orgs (use cached policy instead of hitting config DB), 2) increase routing-policy DB timeout threshold, 3) scale config-db read replicas / connection pool, 4) restart routing-policy pods to flush transient state.

raj: I'll enable cached routing for ZetaCorp for now (cheap, immediate). mike — please start a rolling restart of routing-policy and check DB pool usage.

mike: Doing the rollout restart now.

deploy-bot: deployment"routing-policy" rollout restarted by mike at 2026-03-15T09:30:22Z

mike: Also bumped gateway backend timeout from 3s -> 6s for affected edge nodes (applied to us-west-2 edge group).

lina: I told ZetaCorp we enabled a cached-routing fallback and increased gateway timeout; asked them to verify.

support-bot: Note: Created escalation ticket ESC-1142 and linked SUP-9823 -> ESC-1142.

ZetaCorp (via support): Confirmed reduction in 502s immediately, still seeing occasional 504s for longer requests.

raj: Good. We still need root cause — why did config-db read latency spike and why did session-store show timeouts? Any recent deployments?

mike: No config DB schema changes. I see a batch job that started at 09:10 UTC from analytics doing heavy reads on the same replica — that likely starved read capacity. It coincided with a transient network blip to redis causing a few connection timeouts. Two small failures combined to push routing-policy over threshold.

raj: Action items:
- Short (now): Keep cached-routing for affected orgs for 30m. Monitor errors -> if stable, schedule automated fallback TTL extension.
- Mid (next 2h): Scale config-db read replicas + increase pool max for routing-policy.
- Mid: Add circuit-breaker in routing-policy: on DB timeout return cached policy (if present) rather than 5xx.
- Postmortem: Runbook update to include analytic batch windows and DB throttling.

mike: I've scaled the read replicas by +1 and increased pgBouncer max client connections for routing-policy pool. Monitoring pg stats.

deploy-bot: pgbouncer: scaled connections for app=routing-policy by 50 at 2026-03-15T09:42:10Z

lina: Customer says errors dropped to near-zero after the cached-routing and DB scale. They're grateful but asked for an RCA and fix timeline.

sophia: Product note — we should surface degraded control-plane status to customers earlier (banner + subscribeable incident feed). Add to postmortem.

raj: For the postmortem I'll capture timeline and correlate analytics batch job ID 2026-03-15-ANL-77. Also will add a quick config change to increase routing-policy DB timeout from 1500ms to 2500ms as a temporary cushion while we implement circuit-breaker.

mike: I'll open PR to routing-policy to wrap DB calls with a cached-policy fallback. PR: https://git.internal.redwood/p/routing-policy/pulls/642

lina: Thanks team. I've updated SUP-9823 with mitigation, ESC-1142 will track the infra fix. I'll send ZetaCorp an interim status note and an ETA for the RCA tomorrow EOD.

oncall-bot: alert cleared: 10:05 UTC — control-plane routing-policy 5xx spike remediated (cached-routing + DB scale + restart).

sophia: Follow-ups for product/console: add a 'control-plane degraded' indicator and API to auto-apply cached-routing to affected orgs. Add to roadmap.

raj: Postmortem owners: raj (SRE), mike (eng-runtime), lina (support). Target publish date: 2026-03-17.

mike: Leaving cached-routing on for 30m more. Will revert once p95 reads < 800ms for 10m.

lina: Closing loop with customer now. Thanks. :thumbsup:
